title: Solve Intelligence × NetDocuments: Connected Patent Workflows
summary: Connect NetDocuments with Solve Intelligence to import matter files, find relevant content and save reviewed patent work back to your firm's document system.
body_markdown:
Solve Intelligence's NetDocuments integration lets patent attorneys import matter documents into their project and export finished work back to NetDocuments, without downloading and re-uploading files. A separate, read-only AI connection also lets attorneys search NetDocuments content from chat, with administrator enablement required. The integration is free for Solve customers.


[Drafting](https://www.solveintelligence.com/product/drafting) ,[prosecution](https://www.solveintelligence.com/product/prosecution) and[claim charts](https://www.solveintelligence.com/product/charts) sit alongside invention harvesting in Solve Intelligence’s single AI workspace for patent professionals. The NetDocuments integration brings that workspace closer to where client and matter documents already live.


## Key takeaways


- Attorneys can select multiple NetDocuments files and import them directly into a Solve project.
- Finished work exports back to NetDocuments as DOCX or PDF, as a new file or version.
- A read-only AI connection lets attorneys search and read NetDocuments content from chat.


A patent matter draws on more than the document being drafted or reviewed. Attorneys need to decide which materials are relevant, often working through lengthy invention disclosures, earlier applications, prosecution correspondence and supporting technical documents. Bringing those files into an AI-assisted patent workflow saves time and helps attorneys focus on the work itself.


[NetDocuments](https://www.netdocuments.com/) is a cloud-based document management system trusted by over 7,000 law firms, corporate legal departments and public sector organizations worldwide.


## **Bring matter documents into Solve Intelligence**


From within Solve Intelligence, attorneys can open the NetDocuments file picker and select the files they need, including multiple documents at once. Those files can then be used within the project for drafting, prosecution, claim charting, legal research or portfolio analysis.


An attorney preparing a new application can bring in the invention disclosure, related filings and client specifications. A colleague responding to an office action can assemble earlier responses and supporting technical documents. In each case, the attorney selects the materials that should inform the work, without downloading and re-uploading them through a local machine.


## **Find relevant content through chat**


When the NetDocuments AI connection is enabled, attorneys can select NetDocuments as a source and ask Solve Intelligence to search for documents and read their text. This provides another way to locate relevant material while working in Solve Intelligence.


The AI connection is read-only and uses the attorney's authenticated NetDocuments account. It is separate from file import and export, and requires an eligible NetDocuments subscription and administrator enablement.


## **Save reviewed work back to NetDocuments**


When a document is ready, attorneys can export it directly from Solve Intelligence to NetDocuments as a DOCX or PDF. They choose the destination and can save a new file or create a new version of an existing document. Multiple files can also be exported together.


The result is a straightforward path from source materials to reviewed work: bring the relevant documents into Solve Intelligence, use them in the patent workflow, and return the completed documents to the appropriate NetDocuments location. Transfers are initiated by the user, who decides which files to bring in and where completed work is saved.


The NetDocuments integration is available to Solve Intelligence customers at no additional cost.


## **How to enable the NetDocuments integration**


To enable this connection, organization admins can go to “Settings” in the lower left hand corner of their account. Then, on the left-hand side navigation pane, click “Connectors.” Admins can choose to enable NetDocs as both an external tool and for external storage. If you have any questions, contact your account manager or emailpartnerships@solveintelligence.com .


## **Frequently asked questions**


#### **How do I bring NetDocuments files into Solve Intelligence?** ‍


Open the NetDocuments file picker from within a Solve Intelligence project and select one or more files. They’re available immediately for drafting, prosecution, claim charting, legal research or portfolio analysis, without downloading them first.


#### **Is the NetDocuments integration secure?** ‍


The AI search connection is read-only and runs on the attorney’s own authenticated NetDocuments account, kept separate from file import and export. See Solve Intelligence’s[security page](https://www.solveintelligence.com/security) for more on how data is handled.


#### **Does the integration cost extra?** ‍


No, file import and export are included for all Solve Intelligence customers. The AI search connection additionally requires an eligible NetDocuments subscription and administrator enablement on the NetDocuments side.
